description: This file implements abstract combined logical conditions such as AND, OR, NOT, and XOR for the MiniLang scripting language within the Apache OFBiz framework. It defines the CombinedCondition class, which provides a base for specific condition types via inner factory classes.

classes.name: CombinedCondition
classes.description: An abstract class representing combined logical conditions, including subclasses for AND, OR, NOT, and XOR logic.

methods.name: getSubConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-conditions this combined condition consists of.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Builds a human-readable string representation of the combined condition.

methods.name: CombinedCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the combined condition from an XML element and a simple method, parsing child condition elements.
